alignment.limitation: V1 has no player IDs or stable match IDs. Unique shared context is corroboration within this frozen population, not independently authenticated player identity. Full-population pairing is conditional on preserved V1 ordering.

identity_limitation: Full-population pairing remains conditional on preserved V1.1 row order. V1.1 has no saved match/player IDs; positional metadata and exact metric reproduction do not independently authenticate that order.

data_route.note: Reuses Point 3 private aligned export; its hash first recorded in Point 4. V2 export lineage is inherited from the Point 3 run, not independently reauthenticated by this CSV. Original V2 Parquet bytes are verified; original V1 and metadata are loaded and alignment rechecked. Direct original-Parquet route is available with PyArrow 23+, but was not executed in this environment.

logloss.interpretation: A=V2.1, B=V1.1; all paired quantities conditional on V1 saved order. Descending stable ranking; ties resolved by preserved row position. Contributions divide by full N, not selected N. Net shares can exceed 100% or be negative.

event.convention: Whole-cluster paired multinomial percentile intervals, match-weighted. Cutpoints fixed at original-sample values, including quantile bins; memberships do not split ties. Empty resampled bins are undefined and counted. ECE excludes empty bins; MCE considers occupied bins. Pointwise descriptive intervals conditional on fixed models and bin boundaries; ECE has finite-sample bias. Repeated players across clusters and longer serial dependence remain.

limitations: Full-population pairing remains conditional on preserved V1.1 row order. V1.1 has no saved match/player IDs; positional metadata and exact metric reproduction do not independently authenticate that order.
Historical match/source availability unverified; ten-day cutoff is a conservative assumption, not proof.
17,299 historical rule mappings inferred; four best-of conflicts outside scoring-only correction.
Incomplete outcomes are part of primary frozen population; completion subset is exploratory.
Pointwise fixed-model uncertainty excludes training/model-selection uncertainty and does not remove repeated-player dependence.
ECE/MCE depend on bins, composition and finite-sample noise; grouping hides within-bin miscalibration.
Logistic diagnostics use final-test outcomes; no unbiased recalibration performance is claimed.
No suitable authenticated out-of-sample validation match-probability pair supplied; no calibrator fitted.
Nonlinear scoring may accompany extreme probabilities; comparison cannot establish a Markov causal effect.
Private row-level artifacts require rights clearance; hashes alone do not establish provenance or permissions.
